title: CaseBoxDocument
description: Legal document registered to a matter. May reference an OCR job by value (never by FK).

content_hash.description: Immutable once OCR submitted. Persistence layer enforces immutability.

storage_uri.description: Local filesystem path or opaque URI.

ocr_job_id.description: External-Ref to ocr-persistence by value; case-box never FKs to OCR tables.

submission_hash.description: Canonical OCR submission JSON hash; matches OCR dedupe key.

purpose.description: Workflow-role classification. Orthogonal to doc_type. Absent = 'other' by convention. R-5(a).

work_order_status.description: Lifecycle of a work-order document. One-way invariant: if present, purpose MUST be 'work_order'. NOT required when purpose='work_order'. R-5(b).

supersedes_document_id.description: Optional reference to a prior document this one supersedes (e.g. contract_review_final supersedes contract_review_input). Persistence enforces same-matter same-tenant. R-5(d).

letter_date.description: Free-text date descriptor for purpose='lawyer_letter'. Deliberately NOT a typed date — captures whatever the lawyer wrote on the letter. POST-V1: structured date once lifecycle state machine ships. R-5(c).

service_status.description: Free-text service / delivery status for purpose='lawyer_letter'. R-5(c).

client_authorization_summary.description: Free-text client authorization summary for purpose='lawyer_letter'. R-5(c).

preliminary_evidence_summary.description: Free-text preliminary evidence summary for purpose='lawyer_letter'. R-5(c).

review_date.description: Free-text review date descriptor for purpose='contract_review_*'. Deliberately NOT a typed date. POST-V1: structured date. R-5(c).

final_version_marker.description: Free-text marker on the final-revision document for purpose='contract_review_final'. R-5(c).
